description: Remove an existing signal connection between two nodes, persisting the change in the .tscn. Use get_node_signals first to confirm the connection exists; recovery requires reconnecting via connect_signal. Saves automatically. Returns a plain-text confirmation naming the disconnected signal and target. Errors if the connection does not exist. Errors while a Godot runtime session is active on this project; stop_project (or detach_project) clears it.

method.description: Method name on the target node

nodePath.description: Source node path from scene root

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

signal.description: Signal name on the source node

targetNodePath.description: Target node path from scene root

name: disconnect_signal
